Env is: Netty 4.0.33 with netty-tcnative 1.1.33.Fork10 on osx-x86_64 and OpenSSL 1.0.2d 9 Jul 2015

Maybe related to #4722
@floragunncom but it still fails the handshake right ? At least that is what I see here.

@floragunncom actually I think it only fails in the 4.0 branch and did not in 4.0.33.Final. Could you run again with latest 4.0 branch. That said there is still a small bug which cause the SslHandshakeException have not the correct message. Working on a fix now
